_comment: BENCH-02 (#58) regression-gate baseline. Each value is the MAX min-of-N ns/op observed across 10+ ReleaseFast runs on 2026-06-11 (mixed quiet/loaded host conditions), taken from the BENCH_JSON payload -- the same metric ci/bench_gate.py compares. The gate is one-sided (any single run above baseline*tolerance fails), so the baseline must be a conservative envelope: median-based baselines flapped because inter-run min-of-N spread on this shared host (4-69%, with sub-2ns benches excursing ~60% under load) exceeds the 30% tolerance. Pre-2026-06-11 values were partially hoisting-tainted (Subnet.contains, cosineDistance) and uniformly stale; de-hoisted in P1 then re-baselined. To re-baseline: run `zig build bench -Doptimize=ReleaseFast` at least 10 times on the gate host across varied load, take the per-benchmark max of the BENCH_JSON values.
units: ns/op (min-of-N, N=9 rounds of 100000 iterations each)
